jp_verse:
冬の海は

    言葉を忘れ

    霧だけ残る
en_verse: The winter sea\nforgets all language\nand leaves only mist

jp_verse:
雪の路地で

    手を開く人に

    風も静か
en_verse: In the snowy alley\neven the wind softens\naround open hands

jp_verse:
冬の布が

    光を薄く

    空へ返す
en_verse: Winter cloth\nreturns pale sunlight\nback into the sky

jp_verse:
息ひとつ

    静かな腹に

    冬が宿る
en_verse: A single breath\nsettles in the abdomen\nwhere winter rests

jp_verse:
障子越し

    似た影たちが

    少し違う
en_verse: Beyond the screens\nthe echoed figures\ndiffer slightly

jp_verse:
空の椅子に

    朝の光だけ

    座っている
en_verse: In the empty chair\nonly morning light\nremains seated

jp_verse:
葦を越え

    雪の風だけ

    急いでゆく
en_verse: Across the reeds\nonly the snow wind\nmoves quickly onward

jp_verse:
暗い台所

    米の湯気だけ

    白く生きる
en_verse: In the dark kitchen\nonly the rice steam\nlives in white light

jp_verse:
広い堂に

    ひとりの歌が

    冬へ消える
en_verse: Inside the hall\na solitary song\nvanishes into winter

jp_verse:
折れぬよう

    柔らかな布は

    静かに沈む
en_verse: So it will not break\nthe softened cloth\nsettles quietly

jp_verse:
霧の駅

    来ぬ列車まで

    時が続く
en_verse: At the foggy station\ntime continues onward\nuntil the train arrives

jp_verse:
凍る枝

    触れぬ痛みを

    空へ向ける
en_verse: Frozen branches\nraise untouched pain\ntoward the sky

jp_verse:
古い紙に

    眠る重さを

    灯が守る
en_verse: Within old papers\na quiet weight sleeps\nguarded by lamplight

jp_verse:
障子越し

    姿だけ残り

    名は消える
en_verse: Beyond the shoji\nonly the figure remains\nthe name disappears

jp_verse:
小さな灯

    低い声だけ

    夜を動かす
en_verse: A small candle\nand quiet voices alone\nmove the night

jp_verse:
重い紙を

    開く指先に

    冬の責
en_verse: At the opened document\nwinter responsibility\nrests in the fingers

jp_verse:
寒い土に

    小さな緑を

    手が守る
en_verse: Within the cold soil\ncareful hands protect\na fragile green

jp_verse:
静かな刃

    分けるためだけに

    光を持つ
en_verse: The quiet blade\nholds its light only\nto separate clearly

jp_verse:
鐘ひとつ

    空の広間を

    波のように
en_verse: One temple bell\ncrosses the empty hall\nlike widening water

jp_verse:
灯が消え

    湖の闇だけ

    深く残る
en_verse: After the lamp fades\nonly the darkness of the lake\nremains deep and still
